screen.better_camera.config.title: Better Camera Settings
option.better_camera.enabled.tooltip: Enables or disables all camera damping provided by this mod.
option.better_camera.apply_in_first_pers: Shapes mouse turning in first person. This can introduce aiming latency and is disabled by default.
option.better_camera.apply_in_third_pers: Shapes mouse turning in third person.
option.better_camera.apply_position_damp: Adds only character-motion follow after lock-on, shoulder offsets, distance, rotation, and other camera mods finish resolving their camera.
Controls initial response. Lower values react more immediately when mouse movement begins.
Controls the main camera weight. Higher values produce heavier turning.
option.better_camera.chase_response_time: Controls how long the slow channel takes to pursue the target rotation. Higher values emphasize chasing.
option.better_camera.fast_response_weigh: Share of the final turn assigned to the fast, direct response. Lower values feel heavier.
option.better_camera.chase_response_weig: Share of the cinematic response assigned to the slow chasing channel.
option.better_camera.position_response_t: Controls final-camera follow for character translation, jumping, and eye-height changes without rebuilding third-party rotation, shoulder offset, or distance.
option.better_camera.vertical_response_m: Scales vertical response time relative to horizontal response. Values below 1 settle vertical aim faster.
